dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Which artwork did you like best?
dialogue.reading: ˈwɪtʃ ˈɑːrtwɜːrk dɪd juː ˈlaɪk ˈbɛst?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The abstract river painting. It was the colors that I loved most.
dialogue.reading: ði ˈæbstrækt ˈrɪvər ˈpeɪntɪŋ. ɪt wʌz ðə ˈkʌlərz ðæt aɪ ˈlʌvd ˈmoʊst.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Really? For me, it was the portrait of the old farmer.
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? fər ˈmiː, ɪt wʌz ðə ˈpɔːrtrət əv ði ˈoʊld ˈfɑːrmər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: What did you like about it?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt dɪd juː ˈlaɪk əˈbaʊt ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It was his eyes that I noticed first. They looked so tired.
dialogue.reading: ɪt wʌz hɪz ˈaɪz ðæt aɪ ˈnoʊtɪst ˈfɜːrst. ðeɪ ˈlʊkt soʊ ˈtaɪərd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I read about that artist. It was her grandfather who gave her the inspiration for that portrait.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈrɛd əˈbaʊt ðæt ˈɑːrtɪst. ɪt wʌz hɜːr ˈɡrænfɑːðər huː ˈɡeɪv hɜːr ði ˌɪnspəˈreɪʃən fər ðæt ˈpɔːrtrət.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's lovely. Her technique is amazing, too. The painting looks like a photo.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈlʌvli. hɜːr tɛkˈniːk ɪz əˈmeɪzɪŋ, ˈtuː. ðə ˈpeɪntɪŋ ˈlʊks ˈlaɪk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, it's unique. No one paints like her.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪts juˈniːk. ˈnoʊ ˌwʌn ˈpeɪnts ˈlaɪk hɜːr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Do you think you need talent for that kind of creativity?
dialogue.reading: duː juː ˈθɪŋk juː ˈniːd ˈtælənt fər ðæt ˈkaɪnd əv ˌkriːeɪˈtɪvəti?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hmm. I think it's hard work, not talent, that makes a great artist.
dialogue.reading: ˈhm. aɪ ˈθɪŋk ɪts ˈhɑːrd ˈwɜːrk, ˈnɑːt ˈtælənt, ðæt ˈmeɪks ə ˈɡreɪt ˈɑːrtɪst.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Maybe. Let's ask the guide next time!
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi. ˈlɛts ˈæsk ðə ˈɡaɪd ˈnɛkst ˈtaɪm!
